\textbf{3.4.} Find all the pure-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibria in the following static Bayesian game:

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\tightlist
\item
  Nature determines whether the payoffs are as in Game 1 or as in Game 2, each game being equally likely.
\item
  Player 1 learns whether nature has drawn Game 1 or Game 2, but player 2 does not.
\item
  Player 1 chooses either \(T\) or \(B\); player 2 simultaneously chooses either \(L\) or \(R\).
\item
  Payoffs are given by the game drawn by nature.
\end{enumerate}
